notes: The first physical package exposed FAT-incompatible runtime symlinks and then a missing firmware libutil.so.1. The corrected recipe removes developer-only payloads, rejects all symlinks, carries libutil from Bloom's pinned Miyoo toolchain, and sets the private runtime library path. The pinned upstream exposes lifecycle JSON through home-status, not service-status; the adapter was aligned to that contract. The optional component remains outside stable publication while the immutable CPython binary provenance gate is unresolved.
